title: Finding a financial counsellor
summary: Find free, confidential help and advice from financial counsellors if you are experiencing financial difficulties.
intro:
If you are in financial trouble, you can get help from a financial counsellor.

Community organisations and not-for-profit organisations offer these confidential services for free.

You can contact these organisations to get guidance or advice on your financial situation.
